ayahs.1: Aye imaan walo! Ahd-o-paiman poore karo, tumhare liye mawashi chaupaaye halaal kiye gaye hain bajuz un ke jin ke naam padh kar suna diye jaayenge magar haalat-e-ihraam mein shikaar ko halaal jaanne wale na banna, yaqeenan Allah jo chaahe hukm karta hai.
ayahs.2: Aye imaan walo! Allah ta'ala ke shaair ki be-hurmati na karo na adab wale maheenon ki na haram mein qurbaan hone wale aur patte pehnaaye gaye jaanwaron ki jo Kaaba ko ja rahe hon aur na un logon ki jo Baitullah ke qasd se apne Rabb ta'ala ke fazl aur us ki razajoi ki niyyat se ja rahe hon, haan jab tum ihraam utaar daalo to shikaar khel sakte ho, jin logon ne tumhe Masjid-e-Haram se roka tha un ki dushmani tumhe is baat par aamaada na kare ke tum hadd se guzar jaao, neki aur parhezgaari mein ek doosre ki imdad karte raho aur gunaah aur zulm-o-ziyaadati mein madad na karo, aur Allah ta'ala se darte raho, beshak Allah ta'ala sakht saza dene wala hai.
ayahs.3: Tum par haraam kiya gaya murdaar aur khoon aur khinzeer ka gosht aur jis par Allah ke siwa doosre ka naam pukaara gaya ho aur jo gala ghutne se mara ho aur jo kisi zarb se mar gaya ho aur jo oonchi jagah se gir kar mara ho aur jo kisi ke seeng maarne se mara ho aur jise darindon ne phaad khaaya ho lekin use tum zibah kar daalo to haraam nahi aur jo astanon par zibah kiya gaya ho aur yeh bhi ke qura ke teeron ke zariye falgeeri karo yeh sab badtareen gunaah hain, aaj kuffaar tumhare deen se na-ummeed ho gaye, khabardaar! Tum un se na darna aur mujh se darte rehna, aaj main ne tumhare liye deen ko kaamil kar diya aur tum par apna in'aam bharpoor kar diya aur tumhare liye Islam ke deen hone par raza-mand ho gaya. Pas jo shakhs shiddat ki bhook mein be-qaraar ho jaaye bashart yeh ke kisi gunaah ki taraf us ka mailaan na ho to yaqeenan Allah ta'ala maaf karne wala aur bahut bada meharban hai.
ayahs.4: Aap se daryaft karte hain ke un ke liye kya kuch halaal hai? Aap keh dijiye ke tamaam paak cheezen tumhare liye halaal ki gayi hain, aur jin shikaar khelne wale jaanwaron ko tum ne sudha rakha hai yani jinhe tum thoda bahut woh sikhaate ho jis ki taaleem Allah ta'ala ne tumhe de rakhi hai pas jis shikaar ko woh tumhare liye pakad kar rok rakhen to tum us se kha lo aur us par Allah ta'ala ke naam ka zikr kar liya karo. Aur Allah ta'ala se darte raho, yaqeenan Allah ta'ala jald hisaab lene wala hai.
ayahs.5: Kul paakeeza cheezen aaj tumhare liye halaal ki gayin aur ahl-e-kitaab ka zabeeha tumhare liye halaal hai aur tumhara zabeeha un ke liye halaal hai, aur paak-daaman musalmaan aurten aur jo log tum se pehle kitaab diye gaye hain un ki paak-daaman aurten bhi halaal hain jabke tum un ke mehr ada karo, is tarah ke tum un se ba-qaaida nikaah karo yeh nahi ke alaaniya zina karo ya posheeda badkaari karo, munkireen-e-imaan ke aamaal zaaya aur akaarat hain aur aakhirat mein woh haarne walon mein se hain.
ayahs.6: Aye imaan walo! Jab tum namaz ke liye utho to apne munh ko, aur apne haathon ko kohniyon samet dho lo apne saron ka masah karo aur apne paon ko takhnon samet dho lo, aur agar tum janaabat ki haalat mein ho to ghusl kar lo, haan agar tum beemaar ho ya safar ki haalat mein ho ya tum mein se koi hajat-e-zaroori se faarigh ho kar aaya ho, ya tum aurton se mile ho aur tumhe paani na mile to tum paak mitti se tayammum kar lo, use apne chehron par aur haathon par mal lo Allah ta'ala tum par kisi qism ki tangi daalna nahi chahta balke us ka iraada tumhe paak karne ka aur tumhe apni bharpoor ne'mat dene ka hai, taake tum shukr ada karte raho.
ayahs.7: Tum par Allah ta'ala ki jo ne'maten naazil hui hain unhe yaad rakho aur us ke us ahd ko bhi jis ka tum se muahida hua hai jabke tum ne kaha hum ne suna aur maana aur Allah ta'ala se darte raho, yaqeenan Allah ta'ala dilon ki baaton ka jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.8: Aye imaan walo! Tum Allah ki khaatir haq par qaaim ho jaao, raasti aur insaaf ke saath gawaahi dene wale ban jaao, kisi qaum ki adaawat tumhe khilaaf-e-adl par aamaada na karde, adl kiya karo jo parhezgaari ke ziyaada qareeb hai, aur Allah ta'ala se darte raho, yaqeen maano ke Allah ta'ala tumhare aamaal se ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.9: Allah ta'ala ka waada hai ke jo imaan laayen aur nek kaam karen un ke liye wasee maghfirat aur bahut bada ajr-o-sawaab hai.
ayahs.10: Aur jin logon ne kufr kiya aur hamare ahkaam ko jhutlaaya woh dozakhi hain.
ayahs.11: Aye imaan walo! Allah ta'ala ne jo ihsaan tum par kiya hai use yaad karo jabke ek qaum ne tum par dast-daraazi karni chaahi to Allah ta'ala ne un ke haathon ko tum tak pahunchne se rok diya aur Allah ta'ala se darte raho aur mominon ko Allah ta'ala hi par bharosa karna chaahiye.
ayahs.12: Aur Allah ta'ala ne Bani Israeel se ahd-o-paiman liya aur unhi mein se baarah sardaar hum ne muqarrar farmaaye aur Allah ta'ala ne farma diya ke yaqeenan main tumhare saath hoon, agar tum namaz qaaim rakho ge aur zakaat dete raho ge aur mere Rasoolon ko maante raho ge aur un ki madad karte raho ge aur Allah ta'ala ko behtar qarz dete raho ge to yaqeenan main tumhari buraaiyaan tum se door rakhoonga aur tumhe un jannaton mein le jaaoonga jin ke neeche chashme beh rahe hain, ab is ahd-o-paiman ke baad bhi tum mein se jo inkaari ho jaaye woh yaqeenan raah-e-raast se bhatak gaya.
ayahs.13: Phir un ki ahd-shikni ki wajah se hum ne un par apni laanat naazil farma di aur un ke dil sakht kar diye ke woh kalaam ko us ki jagah se badal daalte hain aur jo kuch naseehat unhe ki gayi thi us ka bahut bada hissa bhula baithe, un ki ek na ek khayaanat par tujhe ittila milti hi rahegi haan thode se aise nahi bhi hain pas tu unhe maaf karta ja aur darguzar karta reh, beshak Allah ta'ala ihsaan karne walon se muhabbat karta hai.
ayahs.14: Aur jo apne aap ko nasraani kehte hain hum ne un se bhi ahd-o-paiman liya, unhon ne bhi us ka bada hissa faraamosh kar diya jo unhe naseehat ki gayi thi, to hum ne bhi un ke aapas mein bughz-o-adaawat daal di jo ta-qayamat rahegi aur jo kuch yeh karte the anqareeb Allah ta'ala unhe sab bata dega.
ayahs.15: Aye ahl-e-kitaab! Yaqeenan tumhare paas hamara Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) aa chuka jo tumhare saamne kitaab Allah ki ba-kasrat aisi baaten zaahir kar raha hai jinhe tum chhupa rahe the aur bahut si baaton se darguzar karta hai, tumhare paas Allah ta'ala ki taraf se noor aur waazeh kitaab aa chuki hai.
ayahs.16: Jis ke zariye se Allah ta'ala unhe jo raza-e-Rabb ke darpe hon salaamati ki raahen batlaata hai aur apni taufeeq se andheron se nikaal kar noor ki taraf laata hai aur raah-e-raast ki taraf un ki rehberi karta hai.
ayahs.17: Yaqeenan woh log kaafir ho gaye jinhon ne kaha ke Allah hi Maseeh ibn Maryam hai, aap un se keh dijiye ke agar Allah ta'ala Maseeh ibn Maryam aur us ki waalida aur roo-e-zameen ke sab logon ko halaak kar dena chaahe to kaun hai jo Allah ta'ala par kuch bhi ikhtiyaar rakhta ho? Aasmaanon-o-zameen aur dono ke darmiyaan ka kul mulk Allah ta'ala hi ka hai, woh jo chaahta hai paida karta hai, aur Allah ta'ala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.18: Yahood-o-nasara kehte hain ke hum Allah ke bete aur us ke dost hain, aap keh dijiye ke phir tumhe tumhare gunaahon ke baais Allah kyun saza deta hai? Nahi balke tum bhi us ki makhlooq mein se ek insaan ho woh jise chaahta hai bakhsh deta hai, aur jise chaahta hai azaab karta hai, zameen-o-aasmaan aur un ke darmiyaan ki har cheez Allah ta'ala ki milkiyat hai aur usi ki taraf lautna hai.
ayahs.19: Aye ahl-e-kitaab! Bilyaqeen hamara Rasool tumhare paas Rasoolon ki aamad ke ek waqfe ke baad aa pahuncha hai. Jo tumhare liye saaf saaf bayaan kar raha hai taake tumhari yeh baat na reh jaaye ke hamare paas to koi bhalaai, buraai sunaane wala aaya hi nahi, pas ab to yaqeenan khushkhabri sunaane wala aur aagaah karne wala aa pahuncha aur Allah ta'ala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.20: Aur yaad karo Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apni qaum se kaha, aye meri qaum ke logo! Allah ta'ala ke us ihsaan ka zikr karo ke us ne tum mein se paighambar banaaye aur tumhe baadshah bana diya aur tumhe woh diya jo tamaam aalam mein kisi ko nahi diya.
ayahs.21: Aye meri qaum walo! Is muqaddas zameen mein daakhil ho jaao jo Allah ta'ala ne tumhare naam likh di hai aur apni pusht ke bal roogardaani na karo ke phir nuqsaan mein ja pado.
ayahs.22: Unhon ne jawaab diya ke aye Moosa wahaan to zor-aawar sarkash log hain aur jab tak woh wahaan se nikal na jaayen hum to hargiz wahaan na jaayenge haan agar woh wahaan se nikal jaayen phir to hum (ba-khushi) chale jaayenge.
ayahs.23: Do shakhs ne jo khuda-tars logon mein se the, jin par Allah ta'ala ka fazl tha kaha ke tum un ke paas darwaaze mein to pahunch jaao, darwaaze mein qadam rakhte hi yaqeenan tum ghaalib aa jaao ge, aur tum agar momin ho to tumhe Allah ta'ala hi par bharosa rakhna chaahiye.
ayahs.24: Qaum ne jawaab diya ke aye Moosa! Jab tak woh wahaan hain tab tak hum hargiz wahaan na jaayenge, is liye tum aur tumhara parwardigaar ja kar dono hi lad-bhidh lo, hum yahin baithe hue hain.
ayahs.25: Moosa (alaihis salaam) kehne lage ilahi! Mujhe to bajuz apne aur mere bhaai ke kisi aur par koi ikhtiyaar nahi, pas tu hum mein aur un naafarmaanon mein judaai karde.
ayahs.26: Irshaad hua ke ab zameen un par chaalees saal tak haraam kar di gayi hai, yeh khaana-badosh idhar udhar sargardaan phirte rahenge is liye tum un faasiqon ke baare mein ghamgeen na hona.
ayahs.27: Aadam (alaihis salaam) ke dono beton ka khara khara haal bhi unhe suna do, un dono ne ek nazraana pesh kiya, un mein se ek ki nazr to qubool ho gayi aur doosre ki maqbool na hui to woh kehne laga ke main tujhe maar hi daaloonga, us ne kaha Allah ta'ala taqwa walon ka hi amal qubool karta hai.
ayahs.28: Go tu mere qatl ke liye dast-daraazi kare lekin main tere qatl ki taraf hargiz apne haath na badhaaoonga, main to Allah ta'ala parwardigaar-e-aalam se khauf khaata hoon.
ayahs.29: Main to chaahta hoon ke tu mera gunaah aur apne gunaah apne sar par rakh le aur dozakiyon mein shamil ho jaaye, zaalimon ka yahi badla hai.
ayahs.30: Pas use us ke nafs ne apne bhaai ke qatl par aamaada kar diya aur us ne use qatl kar daala, jis se nuqsaan paane walon mein se ho gaya.
ayahs.31: Phir Allah ta'ala ne ek kauwe ko bheja jo zameen khod raha tha taake use dikhaye ke woh kis tarah apne bhai ki nash ko chhupa de, woh kehne laga, haaye afsos! Kya main aisa karne se bhi gaya guzra hogaya ke is kauwe ki tarah apne bhai ki laash ko dafna deta? Phir to (bada hi) pashemaan aur sharminda hogaya.
ayahs.32: Isi wajah se hum ne Bani Israeel par yeh likh diya ke jo shakhs kisi ko baghair is ke ke woh kisi ka qaatil ho ya zameen mein fasaad machaane wala ho, qatl kar daale to goya us ne tamaam logon ko qatl kar diya, aur jo shakhs kisi ek ki jaan bacha le, us ne goya tamaam logon ko zinda kar diya aur un ke paas hamare bahut se Rasool zaahir daleelen le kar aaye lekin phir us ke baad bhi un mein ke aksar log zameen mein zulm-o-ziyaadati aur zabardasti karne wale hi rahe.
ayahs.33: Jo Allah ta'ala se aur us ke Rasool se laden aur zameen mein fasaad karte phiren un ki saza yahi hai ke woh qatl kar diye jaayen ya sooli chadha diye jaayen ya mukhalif janib se un ke haath paon kaat diye jaayen, ya unhe jila-watan kar diya jaaye, yeh to hui un ki dunyavi zillat aur khwari, aur aakhirat mein un ke liye bada bhaari azaab hai.
ayahs.34: Haan jo log is se pehle tauba kar len ke tum un par qaabu paa lo to yaqeen maano ke Allah ta'ala bahut badi bakhshish aur rehm-o-karam wala hai.
ayahs.35: Musalmano! Allah ta'ala se darte raho aur us ka qurb talaash karo aur us ki raah mein jihaad karo taake tumhara bhala ho.
ayahs.36: Yaqeen maano ke kaafiron ke liye agar woh sab kuch ho jo saari zameen mein hai balke isi ke misl aur bhi ho aur woh is sab ko qayamat ke din ke azaab ke badle fidiye mein dena chaahen to bhi namumkin hai ke un ka fidiya qubool kar liya jaaye, un ke liye to dardnaak azaab hi hai.
ayahs.37: Yeh chaahenge ke dozakh mein se nikal jaayen lekin yeh hargiz is mein se na nikal sakenge, un ke liye to dawami azaab hain.
ayahs.38: Chori karne wale mard aur aurat ke haath kaat diya karo. Yeh badla hai us ka jo unhon ne kiya. Azaab, Allah ki taraf se aur Allah ta'ala quwwat-o-hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.39: Jo shakhs apne gunaah ke baad tauba kar le aur islaah kar le to Allah ta'ala rehmat ke saath us ki taraf laut'ta hai. Yaqeenan Allah ta'ala maaf farmaane wala meharbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.40: Kya tujhe maloom nahi ke Allah ta'ala hi ke liye zameen-o-aasmaan ki baadshaahat hai? Jise chaahe saza de aur jise chaahe maaf kar de, Allah ta'ala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.41: Aye Rasool! Aap un logon ke peechhe na kudhiye jo kufr mein sabqat kar rahe hain khwah woh un (munaafiqon) mein se hon jo zabaani to imaan ka daawa karte hain lekin haqeeqatan un ke dil ba-imaan nahi aur yahoodiyon mein se kuch log aise hain jo ghalat baaten sunne ke aadi hain aur un logon ke jaasoos hain jo ab tak aap ke paas nahi aaye, woh kalimaat ke asli mauqa ko chhod kar unhe mutaghayyar kar diya karte hain, kehte hain ke agar tum yahi hukm diye jaao to qubool kar lena aur agar yeh hukm na diye jaao to alag thalag rehna aur jis ka kharaab karna Allah ko manzoor ho to aap us ke liye khudai hidayat mein se kisi cheez ke mukhtaar nahi. Allah ta'ala ka iraada un ke dilon ko paak karne ka nahi, un ke liye dunya mein bhi badi zillat aur ruswaai hai aur aakhirat mein bhi un ke liye badi sakht saza hai.
ayahs.42: Yeh kaan laga laga kar jhoot ke sunne wale aur jee bhar bhar kar haraam ke khaane wale hain, agar yeh tumhare paas aayen to tumhe ikhtiyaar hai khwah un ke aapas ka faisla karo khwah un ko taal do, agar tum un se munh bhi pheroge to bhi yeh tum ko hargiz koi zarar nahi pahuncha sakte, aur agar tum faisla karo to un mein adl-o-insaaf ke saath faisla karo, yaqeenan adl walon ke saath Allah mohabbat rakhta hai.
ayahs.43: (Taajjub ki baat hai ke) woh kaise apne paas Taurat hote hue jis mein ahkaam-e-ilahi hain tum ko munsif banaate hain phir us ke baad bhi phir jaate hain, dar-asal yeh imaan-o-yaqeen wale hain hi nahi.
ayahs.44: Hum ne Taurat naazil farmaayi hai jis mein hidayat-o-noor hai, yahoodiyon mein isi Taurat ke saath Allah ta'ala ke maanne wale ambiya (alaihim salaam) aur ahl-e-Allah aur ulema faisle karte the kyunke unhe Allah ki is kitaab ki hifaazat ka hukm diya gaya tha. Aur woh us par iqraari gawaah the ab tumhe chaahiye ke logon se na daro aur sirf mera dar rakho, meri aayaton ko thode thode mol par na becho, jo log Allah ki utaari hui wahi ke saath faisle na karen woh (poore aur pukhta) kaafir hain.
ayahs.45: Aur hum ne yahoodiyon ke zimma Taurat mein yeh baat muqarrar kar di thi ke jaan ke badle jaan aur aankh ke badle aankh aur naak ke badle naak aur kaan ke badle kaan aur daant ke badle daant aur khaas zakhmon ka bhi badla hai, phir jo shakhs is ko maaf kar de to woh us ke liye kaffara hai, aur jo log Allah ke naazil kiye hue ke mutaabiq hukm na karen, wahi log zaalim hain.
ayahs.46: Aur hum ne un ke peechhe Eesa bin Maryam ko bheja jo apne se pehle ki kitaab yaani Taurat ki tasdeeq karne wale the aur hum ne unhe Injeel ata farmaayi jis mein noor aur hidayat thi aur woh apne se pehle ki kitaab Taurat ki tasdeeq karti thi aur woh saraasar hidayat-o-naseehat thi parsa logon ke liye.
ayahs.47: Aur Injeel walon ko bhi chaahiye ke Allah ta'ala ne jo kuch Injeel mein naazil farmaaya hai isi ke mutaabiq hukm karen aur jo Allah ta'ala ke naazil karda se hi hukm na karen woh (badkaar) faasiq hain.
ayahs.48: Aur hum ne aap ki taraf haq ke saath yeh kitaab naazil farmaayi hai jo apne se agli kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne wali hai aur un ki muhafiz hai. Is liye aap un ke aapas ke maamlaat mein isi Allah ki utaari hui kitaab ke saath hukm kijiye, is haq se hat kar un ki khwahishon ke peechhe na jaaiye tum mein se har ek ke liye hum ne ek dastoor aur raah muqarrar kar di hai. Agar manzoor-e-Maula hota to tum sab ko ek hi ummat bana deta, lekin us ki chaahat hai ke jo tumhe diya hai is mein tumhe aazmaaye, tum nekiyon ki taraf jaldi karo, tum sab ka ruju Allah hi ki taraf hai, phir woh tumhe har woh cheez bata dega jis mein tum ikhtilaaf karte rehte ho.
ayahs.49: Aap un ke maamlaat mein Khuda ki naazil karda wahi ke mutaabiq hi hukm kiya kijiye, un ki khwahishon ki taabedaari na kijiye aur un se hoshyaar rahiye ke kahin yeh aap ko Allah ke utaare hue kisi hukm se idhar udhar na karen, agar yeh log munh pher len to yaqeen karen ke Allah ka iraada yahi hai ke unhe un ke baaz gunaahon ki saza de hi daale aur aksar log na-farmaan hi hote hain.
ayahs.50: Kya yeh log phir se jaahiliyat ka faisla chaahte hain yaqeen rakhne wale logon ke liye Allah ta'ala se behtar faisle aur hukm karne wala kaun ho sakta hai?
ayahs.51: Aye imaan walo! Tum yahood-o-nasara ko dost na banao yeh to aapas mein hi ek doosre ke dost hain. Tum mein se jo bhi un mein kisi se dosti kare woh be-shak unhi mein se hai, zaalimon ko Allah ta'ala hargiz raah-e-raast nahi dikhaata.
ayahs.52: Aap dekhenge ke jin ke dilon mein bimaari hai woh daud daud kar un mein ghus rahe hain aur kehte hain ke hamein khatra hai, aisa na ho ke koi haadsa hum par pad jaaye bahut mumkin hai ke Allah ta'ala fatah de de. Ya apne paas se koi aur cheez laaye phir to yeh apne dilon mein chhupaayi hui baaton par (be-tarah) naadim hone lagenge.
ayahs.53: Aur imaan wale kahenge, kya yahi woh log hain jo bade mubaligha se Allah ki qasmen kha kha kar kehte hain ke hum tumhare saath hain. Un ke aamaal ghaarat hue aur yeh naakaam hogaye.
ayahs.54: Aye imaan walo! Tum mein se jo shakhs apne deen se phir jaaye to Allah ta'ala bahut jald aisi qaum ko laayega jo Allah ki mahboob hogi aur woh bhi Allah se mohabbat rakhti hogi woh narm dil honge musalmano par aur sakht aur tez honge kuffaar par, Allah ki raah mein jihaad karenge aur kisi malaamat karne wale ki malaamat ki parwah bhi na karenge, yeh hai Allah ta'ala ka fazl jise chaahe de, Allah ta'ala badi wusat wala aur zabardast ilm wala hai.
ayahs.55: (Musalmano)! Tumhara dost khud Allah hai aur us ka Rasool hai aur imaan wale hain jo namazon ki paabandi karte hain aur zakaat ada karte hain aur woh ruku (khushu-o-khuzu) karne wale hain.
ayahs.56: Aur jo shakhs Allah ta'ala se aur us ke Rasool se aur musalmano se dosti kare, woh yaqeen maane ke Allah ta'ala ki jamaat hi ghaalib rahegi.
ayahs.57: Musalmano! Un logon ko dost na banao jo tumhare deen ko hansi khel banaaye hue hain (khwah) woh un mein se hon jo tum se pehle kitaab diye gaye ya kuffaar hon agar tum momin ho to Allah ta'ala se darte raho.
ayahs.58: Aur jab tum namaz ke liye pukaarte ho to woh ise hansi khel thahra lete hain. Yeh is waaste ke be-aql hain.
ayahs.59: Aap keh dijiye aye yahoodiyon aur nasraaniyo! Tum hum se sirf is wajah se dushmaniyaan kar rahe ho ke hum Allah ta'ala par aur jo kuch hamari jaanib naazil kiya gaya hai aur jo kuch is se pehle utaara gaya hai us par imaan laaye hain aur is liye bhi ke tum mein aksar faasiq hain.
ayahs.60: Keh dijiye ke kya main tumhe bataoon? Ke is se bhi ziyaada bure ajr paane wala Allah ta'ala ke nazdeek kaun hai? Woh jis par Allah ta'ala ne laanat ki aur us par woh ghussa hua aur un mein se baaz ko bandar aur soor bana diya aur jinhon ne maboodaan-e-baatil ki parastish ki, yahi log badtar darje wale hain aur yahi raah-e-raast se bahut ziyaada bhatakne wale hain.
ayahs.61: Aur jab tumhare paas aate hain to kehte hain ke hum imaan laaye haalaanke woh kufr liye hue hi aaye the aur isi kufr ke saath hi gaye bhi aur yeh jo kuch chhupa rahe hain use Allah ta'ala khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.62: Aap dekhenge ke un mein se aksar gunaah ke kaamon ki taraf aur zulm-o-ziyaadti ki taraf aur maal-e-haraam khaane ki taraf lapak rahe hain, jo kuch yeh kar rahe hain woh nihaayat bure kaam hain.
ayahs.63: Unhe un ke abid-o-alim jhoot baaton ke kehne aur haraam cheezon ke khaane se kyun nahi rokte, be-shak bura kaam hai jo yeh kar rahe hain.
ayahs.64: Aur yahoodiyon ne kaha ke Allah ta'ala ke haath bandhe hue hain. Unhi ke haath bandhe hue hain aur un ke is qaul ki wajah se un par laanat ki gayi, balke Allah ta'ala ke dono haath khule hue hain. Jis tarah chaahta hai kharch karta hai aur jo kuch teri taraf tere Rabb ki jaanib se utaara jaata hai woh un mein se aksar ko to sarkashi aur kufr mein aur badha deta hai aur hum ne un mein aapas mein hi qayamat tak ke liye adaawat aur bughz daal diya hai, woh jab kabhi ladaai ki aag ko bhadkaana chaahte hain to Allah ta'ala use bujha deta hai, yeh mulk bhar mein shar-o-fasaad machaate phirte hain aur Allah ta'ala fasaadiyon se muhabbat nahi karta.
ayahs.65: Aur agar yeh ahl-e-kitaab imaan laate aur taqwa ikhtiyaar karte to hum un ki tamaam buraaiyaan maaf farma dete aur zaroor unhe rahat-o-aram ki jannaton mein le jaate.
ayahs.66: Aur agar yeh log Taurat-o-Injeel aur un ki jaanib jo kuch Allah ta'ala ki taraf se naazil farmaya gaya hai, un ke poore paaband rehte to yeh log apne oopar se aur neeche se roziyaan paate aur khaate, ek jamaat to un mein se darmiyaana-rawish ki hai, baaqi un mein se bahut se logon ke bure aamaal hain.
ayahs.67: Aye Rasool! Jo kuch bhi aap ki taraf aap ke Rabb ki jaanib se naazil kiya gaya hai pahuncha dijiye. Agar aap ne aisa na kiya to aap ne Allah ki risaalat ada nahi ki, aur aap ko Allah ta'ala logon se bacha lega, be-shak Allah ta'ala kaafir logon ko hidayat nahi deta.
ayahs.68: Aap keh dijiye ke aye ahl-e-kitaab! Tum dar-asal kisi cheez par nahi jab tak ke Taurat-o-Injeel ko aur jo kuch tumhari taraf tumhare Rabb ki taraf se utaara gaya hai qaaim na karo, jo kuch aap ki jaanib aap ke Rabb ki taraf se utra hai woh un mein se bahuton ko sharaarat aur inkaar mein aur bhi badhaayega hi, to aap un kaafiron par ghamgeen na hon.
ayahs.69: Musalmaan, yahoodi, sitaara-parast aur nasraani koi ho, jo bhi Allah ta'ala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan laaye aur nek amal kare woh mehaz be-khauf rahega aur bilkul be-gham ho jaayega.
ayahs.70: Hum ne bilyaqeen Bani Israeel se ahd-o-paimaan liya aur un ki taraf Rasoolon ko bheja, jab kabhi Rasool un ke paas woh ahkaam le kar aaye jo un ki apni mansha ke khilaaf the to unhon ne un ki ek jamaat ki takzeeb ki aur ek jamaat ko qatl kar diya.
ayahs.71: Aur samajh baithe ke koi pakad na hogi, pas andhe behre ban baithe, phir Allah ta'ala ne un ki tauba qubool ki, is ke baad bhi un mein se aksar andhe behre ho gaye. Allah ta'ala un ke aamaal ko bakhoobi dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.72: Be-shak woh log kaafir ho gaye jin ka qaul hai ke Maseeh ibn Maryam hi Allah hai haalaanke khud Maseeh ne un se kaha tha ke aye Bani Israeel! Allah hi ki ibaadat karo jo mera aur tumhara sab ka Rabb hai, yaqeen maano ke jo shakhs Allah ke saath shareek karta hai Allah ta'ala ne us par jannat haraam kar di hai, us ka thikaana jahannam hi hai aur gunahgaaron ki madad karne wala koi nahi hoga.
ayahs.73: Woh log bhi qatan kaafir ho gaye jinhon ne kaha, Allah teen mein ka teesra hai, dar-asal siwa Allah ta'ala ke koi mabood nahi. Agar yeh log apne is qaul se baaz na rahe to un mein se jo kufr par rahenge, unhe alamnak azaab zaroor pahunchega.
ayahs.74: Yeh log kyun Allah ta'ala ki taraf nahi jhukte aur kyun istighfaar nahi karte? Allah ta'ala to bahut hi bakhshne wala aur bada hi meharban hai.
ayahs.75: Maseeh ibn Maryam siwa paighambar hone ke aur kuch bhi nahi, is se pehle bhi bahut se paighambar ho chuke hain, un ki waalida ek raast-baaz aurat thin, dono maa bete khaana khaaya karte the, aap dekhiye ke kis tarah hum un ke saamne daleelen rakhte hain phir ghaur kijiye ke kis tarah woh phire jaate hain.
ayahs.76: Aap keh dijiye ke kya tum Allah ke siwa un ki ibaadat karte ho jo na tumhare kisi nuqsaan ke maalik hain na kisi nafa ke, Allah hi khoob sunne aur poori tarah jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.77: Keh dijiye aye ahl-e-kitaab! Apne deen mein na-haq ghulu aur ziyaadti na karo aur un logon ki nafsaani khwaahishon ki pairwi na karo jo pehle se behak chuke hain aur bahuton ko behka bhi chuke hain aur seedhi raah se hat gaye hain.
ayahs.78: Bani Israeel ke kaafiron par (Hazrat) Daaood (alaihis salaam) aur (Hazrat) Eesa bin Maryam (alaihis salaam) ki zabaani laanat ki gayi is wajah se ke woh naafarmaaniyaan karte the aur had se aage badh jaate the.
ayahs.79: Aapas mein ek doosre ko bure kaamon se jo woh karte the rokte na the jo kuch bhi yeh karte the yaqeenan woh bahut bura tha.
ayahs.80: Un mein se bahut se logon ko aap dekhenge ke woh kaafiron se dostiyaan karte hain, jo kuch unhon ne apne liye aage bhej rakha hai woh bahut bura hai ke Allah ta'ala un se naaraaz hua aur woh hamesha azaab mein rahenge.
ayahs.81: Agar unhe Allah ta'ala par aur nabi par aur jo naazil kiya gaya hai us par imaan hota to yeh kuffaar se dostiyaan na karte, lekin un mein ke aksar log faasiq hain.
ayahs.82: Yaqeenan aap imaan walon ka sab se ziyaada dushman yahoodiyon aur mushrikon ko paayenge aur imaan walon se sab se ziyaada dosti ke qareeb aap yaqeenan unhe paayenge jo apne aap ko nasara kehte hain, yeh is liye ke un mein ulama aur ibaadat ke liye gosha-nasheen afraad paaye jaate hain aur is wajah se ke woh takabbur nahi karte.
ayahs.83: Aur jab woh Rasool ki taraf naazil karda (kalaam) ko sunte hain to aap un ki aankhen aansoo se behti hui dekhte hain is sabab se ke unhon ne haq ko pehchaan liya, woh kehte hain ke aye hamare Rabb! Hum imaan le aaye pas tu hum ko bhi un logon ke saath likh le jo tasdeeq karte hain.
ayahs.84: Aur hamare paas kaun sa uzr hai ke hum Allah ta'ala par aur jo haq hum ko pahuncha hai us par imaan na laayen aur hum is baat ki umeed rakhte hain ke hamara Rabb hum ko nek logon ki rafaqat mein daakhil kar dega.
ayahs.85: Is liye un ko Allah ta'ala un ke is qaul ki wajah se aise baagh dega jin ke neeche nahren jaari hongi, yeh un mein hamesha hamesha rahenge aur nek logon ka yahi badla hai.
ayahs.86: Aur jin logon ne kufr kiya aur hamari aayaat ko jhutlaate rahe woh log dozakh wale hain.
ayahs.87: Aye imaan walo! Allah ta'ala ne jo paakeeza cheezen tumhare waaste halaal ki hain un ko haraam mat karo aur had se aage mat niklo, be-shak Allah ta'ala had se nikalne walon ko pasand nahi karta.
ayahs.88: Aur Allah ta'ala ne jo cheezen tum ko di hain un mein se halaal marghoob cheezen khaao aur Allah ta'ala se daro jis par tum imaan rakhte ho.
ayahs.89: Allah ta'ala tumhari qasmon mein laghw qasam par tum se muakhaza nahi farmata lekin muakhaza is par farmata hai ke tum jin qasmon ko mazboot kar do. Is ka kaffara das mohtaajon ko khaana dena hai ausat darje ka jo apne ghar walon ko khilaate ho ya un ko kapda dena ya ek ghulaam ya laundi aazaad karna hai aur jis ko maqdoor na ho to teen din ke roze hain yeh tumhari qasmon ka kaffara hai jabke tum qasam kha lo aur apni qasmon ka khayaal rakho! Isi tarah Allah ta'ala tumhare waaste apne ahkaam bayaan farmata hai taake tum shukr karo.
ayahs.90: Aye imaan walo! Baat yahi hai ke sharaab aur juaa aur thaan aur faal nikaalne ke paanse ke teer, yeh sab gandi baaten, shaitaani kaam hain, un se bilkul alag raho taake tum falah-yaab ho.
ayahs.91: Shaitaan to yun chaahta hai ke sharaab aur juye ke zariye se tumhare aapas mein adaawat aur bughz waaqe kara de aur Allah ta'ala ki yaad se aur namaz se tum ko baaz rakhe, so ab bhi baaz aa jaao.
ayahs.92: Aur tum Allah ta'ala ki itaa'at karte raho aur Rasool ki itaa'at karte raho aur ihtiyaat rakho. Agar iraaz karoge to yeh jaan rakho ke hamare Rasool ke zimme sirf saaf saaf pahuncha dena hai.
ayahs.93: Aise logon par jo ke imaan rakhte hon aur nek kaam karte hon is cheez mein koi gunaah nahi jis ko woh khaate peete hon jabke woh log taqwa rakhte hon aur imaan rakhte hon aur nek kaam karte hon phir parhezgaari karte hon aur imaan rakhte hon phir parhezgaari karte hon aur khoob nek amal karte hon, Allah aise nekokaaron se muhabbat rakhta hai.
ayahs.94: Aye imaan walo! Allah ta'ala qadre shikaar se tumhara imtihaan karega jin tak tumhare haath aur tumhare neze pahunch sakenge taake Allah ta'ala maloom kar le ke kaun shakhs us se bin dekhe darta hai, so jo shakhs is ke baad hadd se niklega us ke waaste dardnaak saza hai.
ayahs.95: Aye imaan walo! (Wahshi) shikaar ko qatl mat karo jabke tum haalat-e-ihraam mein ho. Aur jo shakhs tum mein se is ko jaan-boojh kar qatl karega to us par fidya waajib hoga jo ke musaawi hoga us jaanwar ke jis ko us ne qatl kiya hai jis ka faisla tum mein se do motabar shakhs kar den khwaah woh fidya khaas chaupaayon mein se ho jo niyaaz ke taur par Kaaba tak pahunchaaya jaaye aur khwaah kaffara masaakeen ko de diya jaaye aur khwaah us ke baraabar roze rakh liye jaayen taake apne kiye shamat ka maza chakhe, Allah ta'ala ne guzishta ko maaf kar diya aur jo shakhs phir aisi hi harkat karega to Allah intiqam lega aur Allah zabardast hai intiqam lene wala.
ayahs.96: Tumhare liye darya ka shikaar pakadna aur us ka khaana halaal kiya gaya hai. Tumhare faaida ke waaste aur musaafiron ke waaste aur khushki ka shikaar pakadna tumhare liye haraam kiya gaya hai jab tak tum haalat-e-ihraam mein raho aur Allah ta'ala se daro jis ke paas jama kiye jaaoge.
ayahs.97: Allah ne Kaaba ko jo adab ka makaan hai logon ke qaaim rehne ka sabab qaraar de diya aur izzat wale maheene ko bhi aur haram mein qurbaani hone wale jaanwar ko bhi aur un jaanwaron ko bhi jin ke gale mein patte hon, yeh is liye taake tum is baat ka yaqeen kar lo ke beshak Allah tamaam aasmaanon aur zameen ke andar ki cheezon ka ilm rakhta hai aur beshak Allah sab cheezon ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.98: Tum yaqeen jaano ke Allah ta'ala saza bhi sakht dene wala hai aur Allah ta'ala badi maghfirat aur badi rehmat wala bhi hai.
ayahs.99: Rasool ke zimme to sirf pahunchaana hai. Aur Allah ta'ala sab jaanta hai jo kuch tum zaahir karte ho aur jo kuch posheeda rakhte ho.
ayahs.100: Aap farma dijiye ke napaak aur paak baraabar nahi go aap ko napaak ki kasrat bhali lagti ho, Allah ta'ala se darte raho aye aqal mando! Taake tum kaamyaab ho.
ayahs.101: Aye imaan walo! Aisi baaten mat poochho ke agar tum par zaahir kar di jaayen to tumhe naagawaar hon aur agar tum zamaana-e-nuzool-e-Quran mein un baaton ko poochhoge to tum par zaahir kar di jaayengi, sawaalaat-e-guzishta Allah ne maaf kar diye aur Allah badi maghfirat wala bade hilm wala hai.
ayahs.102: Aisi baaten tum se pehle aur logon ne bhi poochhi thin, phir un baaton ke munkir hogaye.
ayahs.103: Allah ta'ala ne na baheera ko mashroo kiya hai aur na saiba ko aur na waseela ko aur na ham ko lekin jo log kaafir hain woh Allah ta'ala par jhoot lagaate hain aur aksar kaafir aql nahi rakhte.
ayahs.104: Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke Allah ta'ala ne jo ahkaam naazil farmaaye hain un ki taraf aur Rasool ki taraf rujoo karo to kehte hain ke hum ko wahi kaafi hai jis par hum ne apne badon ko paaya, kya agarche un ke bade na kuch samajh rakhte hon aur na hidayat rakhte hon.
ayahs.105: Aye imaan walo! Apni fikr karo, jab tum raah-e-raast par chal rahe ho to jo shakhs gumraah rahe us se tumhara koi nuqsaan nahi. Allah hi ke paas tum sab ko jaana hai phir woh tum sab ko batla dega jo kuch tum sab karte the.
ayahs.106: Aye imaan walo! Tumhare aapas mein do shakhs ka gawaah hona munaasib hai jabke tum mein se kisi ko maut aane lage aur wasiyyat karne ka waqt ho, woh do shakhs aise hon ke deendaar hon khwaah tum mein se hon ya ghair logon mein se do shakhs hon agar tum kahin safar mein gaye ho aur tumhe maut aa jaaye agar tum ko shubha ho to un dono ko baad namaz rok lo phir dono Allah ki qasam khaayen ke hum is qasam ke iwaz koi nafa nahi lena chaahte agarche koi qaraabatdaar bhi ho aur Allah ta'ala ki baat ko hum posheeda na karenge, hum is haalat mein sakht gunahgaar honge.
ayahs.107: Phir agar is ki ittela ho ke woh dono gawaah kisi gunaah ke murtakib hue hain to un logon mein se jin ke muqaable mein gunaah ka irtikaab hua tha aur do shakhs jo sab mein qareeb tar hain jahaan woh dono khade hue the yeh dono khade hon phir dono Allah ki qasam khaayen ke bilyaqeen hamari yeh qasam un dono ki is qasam se ziyaada raast hai aur hum ne zara tajaawuz nahi kiya, hum is haalat mein sakht zaalim honge.
ayahs.108: Yeh qareeb zariya hai is amar ka ke woh log waaqia ko theek taur par zaahir karen ya is baat se dar jaayen ke un se qasmen lene ke baad qasmen ulti pad jaayengi aur Allah ta'ala se daro aur suno! Aur Allah ta'ala faasiq logon ko hidayat nahi karta.
ayahs.109: Jis roz Allah ta'ala tamaam paighambaron ko jama karega, phir irshaad farmaayega ke tum ko kya jawaab mila tha, woh arz karenge ke hum ko kuch khabar nahi, tu hi beshak posheeda baaton ko poora jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.110: Jabke Allah ta'ala irshaad farmaayega ke aye Eesa bin Maryam! Mera in'aam yaad karo jo tum par aur tumhari waalida par hua hai, jab main ne tum ko Rooh-ul-Qudus se taayeed di. Tum logon se kalaam karte the god mein bhi aur badi umr mein bhi aur jabke main ne tum ko kitaab aur hikmat ki baaten aur Taurat aur Injeel ki taaleem di aur jabke tum mere hukm se gaare se ek shakl banaate the jaise parinde ki shakl hoti hai phir tum us ke andar phoonk maar dete the jis se woh parind ban jaata tha mere hukm se aur tum achha kar dete the maadar-zaad andhe ko aur kodhi ko mere hukm se aur jabke tum murdon ko nikaal kar khada kar lete the mere hukm se aur jabke main ne Bani Israeel ko tum se baaz rakha jab tum un ke paas daleelen le kar aaye the phir un mein jo kaafir the unhon ne kaha tha ke bajuz khule jaadu ke yeh aur kuch bhi nahi.
ayahs.111: Aur jabke main ne hawariyeen ko hukm diya ke tum mujh par aur mere Rasool par imaan laao, unhon ne kaha ke hum imaan laaye aur aap shaahid rahiye ke hum poore farmabardaar hain.
ayahs.112: Woh waqt yaad ke qaabil hai jabke hawariyon ne arz kiya ke aye Eesa bin Maryam! Kya aap ka Rabb aisa kar sakta hai ke hum par aasmaan se ek khwan (dastarkhwan) naazil farma de? Aap ne farmaya ke Allah se daro agar tum imaan wale ho.
ayahs.113: Woh bole ke hum yeh chaahte hain ke is mein se khaayen aur hamare dilon ko poora itminan ho jaaye aur hamara yeh yaqeen aur badh jaaye ke aap ne hum se sach bola hai aur hum gawaahi dene walon mein se ho jaayen.
ayahs.114: Eesa ibn-e-Maryam ne dua ki ke aye Allah aye hamare parwardigaar! Hum par aasmaan se khaana naazil farma! Ke woh hamare liye yaani hum mein jo awwal hain aur jo baad ke hain sab ke liye ek khushi ki baat ho jaaye aur teri taraf se ek nishaani ho jaaye aur tu hum ko rizq ata farma de aur tu sab ata karne walon se achha hai.
ayahs.115: Haq ta'ala ne irshaad farmaya ke main woh khaana tum logon par naazil karne wala hoon, phir jo shakhs tum mein se is ke baad na-haq-shanaasi karega to main us ko aisi saza doonga ke woh saza dunya jahaan walon mein se kisi ko na doonga.
ayahs.116: Aur woh waqt bhi qaabil-e-zikr hai jabke Allah ta'ala farmaayega ke aye Eesa ibn-e-Maryam! Kya tum ne in logon se keh diya tha ke mujh ko aur meri maa ko bhi ilaawa Allah ke mabood qaraar de lo! Eesa arz karenge ke main to tujh ko munazzah samajhta hoon, mujh ko kisi tarah zeba na tha ke main aisi baat kehta jis ke kehne ka mujh ko koi haq nahi, agar main ne kaha hoga to tujh ko is ka ilm hoga. Tu, tu mere dil ke andar ki baat bhi jaanta hai aur main tere nafs mein jo kuch hai us ko nahi jaanta. Tamaam ghaibon ka jaanne wala tu hi hai.
ayahs.117: Main ne to un se aur kuch nahi kaha magar sirf wahi jo tu ne mujh se kehne ko farmaya tha ke tum Allah ki bandagi ikhtiyaar karo jo mera bhi Rabb hai aur tumhara bhi Rabb hai. Main un par gawaah raha jab tak un mein raha. Phir jab tu ne mujh ko utha liya to, tu hi un par muttala raha. Aur tu har cheez ki poori khabar rakhta hai.
ayahs.118: Agar tu un ko saza de to yeh tere bande hain aur agar tu un ko maaf farma de to, tu zabardast hai hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.119: Allah irshaad farmaayega ke yeh woh din hai ke jo log sachche the un ka sachcha hona un ke kaam aayega, un ko baagh milenge jin ke neeche nahren jaari hongi jin mein woh hamesha hamesha ko rahenge. Allah ta'ala un se raazi aur khush aur yeh Allah se raazi aur khush hain, yeh badi (bhaari) kaamyaabi hai.
ayahs.120: Allah hi ki hai saltanat aasmaanon ki aur zameen ki aur un cheezon ki jo un mein maujood hain aur woh har shai par poori qudrat rakhta hai.
